hypothesis: A compact recurrent model can compress the native three-turn teacher's opponent-response and follow-up state transition, rather than fitting atomic action labels, complete-plan log probabilities, or a scalar score head. Predicting scored state components should localize credit to each candidate turn and preserve the unchanged game evaluator at inference.
arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two-player, action limit2400, original rules, no fog or diplomacy
teacher: At every atomic action, native replanned three-turn search uses root node budget256, slate8, beam32, branch48, maximum24 actions per turn, opponent full-turn node budget64 and root follow-up full-turn node budget32. Candidate ordering and tie resolution must match the current SearchAgent exactly. No terminal oracle may be used online.
collection: On each fit and offline-validation map, run the exact teacher as each root seat against both frozen routed-v6 direct and native teacher opponents, four independent games per map, to actual termination. Record each root-seat atomic decision at own-action indices 0,1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256 if reached. For each sampled state, return the native top8 completed-turn plan indices, its existing 16-dimensional exact native action trace, exact post-turn scored-state component vector, exact searched opponent-reply state and root-follow-up state component vectors, and terminal outcome class at each branch. Replay every returned plan and searched continuation and verify the full Game, including hidden RNG, before accepting a record. Each game and branch is labeled terminal, nonterminal finite-horizon, or action-limit censored; any fit or offline game censoring fails collection rather than silently dropping examples. Calibration, validation and game windows are never used for optimization or hyperparameter choice.
scored_components: Use root-relative signed counts for territory, units of strengths1/2/3/4+, capitals, farms, towers, strong towers, trees, graves, defense sum, treasury, income, upkeep and provinces. The fixed original position_score coefficients reconstruct every nonterminal target exactly. Terminal win/loss is a separate three-class target, not folded into a huge regression number. Inputs contain only root and exact post-candidate public component vectors, static score, and candidate action trace; hidden RNG and searched opponent/follow-up actions are targets only, never online inputs.
model_and_objective: One GRU over the 16-dimensional per-action trace with hidden width32; concatenate its last real state with normalized root and post-candidate component vectors, pass through one width32 ReLU layer, and output component deltas for the opponent-reply and root-follow-up states plus three terminal-class logits. Normalize signed count components by20, money by50, income/upkeep by20, and province count by5. Train all parameters from a fixed initialization seed6600000 with map-balanced Huber loss on both normalized state-delta vectors plus equal-weight three-class cross-entropy, AdamW learning rate0.001, weight decay0.01, gradient clip1.0, exactly two epochs. Do not train against candidate scalar scores or teacher action labels. Candidate predicted score is the unchanged position_score coefficient dot product of predicted follow-up components, plus a fixed1000 times predicted win-minus-loss probability; root-candidate terminal results already visible after exact replay retain their exact terminal ordering. Choose the highest predicted score with the existing static-score then candidate-index tie order. Execute only the first legal action and replan on the next atomic decision. No cached hidden plan, threshold override, model ensemble, validation retuning or terminal oracle online.
resource_gate: Before fit collection, use native-teacher roll-in against the same two opponent arms and sample the same ten action-index positions on all eight calibration maps and both root seats; time a randomly initialized model on the exact inference path without playing its choices. Require every candidate plan and component vector to replay exactly, zero censor, full selector median per-action wall time at most80% of native teacher, p95 no greater than native teacher p95, and both seat medians at most80% of teacher. Failure stops before fit data or training. Do not relax this gate or alter width, slate or model on calibration maps.
offline_gate: On all64 independent validation maps, require full four-arm terminal collection with zero censor, exact replay, map-balanced normalized follow-up-component MAE at least10% lower than the fixed no-response baseline that predicts the post-candidate components unchanged, and teacher-selected candidate agreement versus the static top candidate with independent-map exact two-sided sign p<0.05 and nonnegative agreement gain for both root seats. Record every component and seat result, including failures. Failure rejects the checkpoint and leaves all game windows untouched; no tuning on validation.
game_gates: Only after the offline gate, play complete both-seat independent-map direct head-to-head games against the frozen routed-v6 checkpoint on seed6603000, and separate complete direct head-to-head games against the native replanned teacher on seed6604000. All game windows require zero timeout and zero action-limit censor for a terminal-strength claim; any failure is counted as a candidate loss while also failing the zero-censor promotion gate. Versus direct require at least160/256 candidate terminal wins, at least65/128 in each candidate seat, and independent-map sign p<0.05 against direct self-play on the same map/seat pool. Versus teacher require at least64/256 candidate terminal wins and at least28/128 in each candidate seat. Report actual paired fixed-pool Elo and map-bootstrap95% intervals, never global Elo. Both gates must pass before the final window.
promotion_gate: On disjoint seed6605000 play both-seat complete candidate-versus-direct and candidate-versus-teacher games, each256 maps, with the same zero-censor, per-seat, map-sign and teacher-win thresholds scaled to512 games. On separate disjoint Generic, Online Default and Classic Slay runtime windows, require median candidate CPU no more than80% of native replanned teacher and p95 candidate wall no worse than teacher in each profile, exact legal actions, and explicit terminal versus finite-horizon counts; Classic Slay nonterminal results cannot support a terminal strength claim. No Site/rated-bot promotion before all applicable gates and browser WASM equivalence/latency checks pass, and owner-only access must be retained.
stopping_and_integrity: No architecture, objective, seed, threshold, loss weight or gate change after the first calibration result. If code or data integrity fails before a window is opened, repair and reverify against the same committed protocol; if an outcome gate fails, reject that checkpoint and do not run its reserved downstream windows. Keep raw per-map/seat ledgers, checkpoint hashes, exact terminal/censor counts, native CPU and wall timings. Previous inspected windows through seed6591000 and all reserved earlier failed-student windows remain excluded.
compute: Heavy compute only on SSH server fedora-toolbox scratch, one CPU15 pinned nice19 with Rayon/BLAS/torch capped, bounded output and no private-data inspection or preemption. Reinspect shared CPU, RAM, swap and disk before each job. Never edit the dirty remote original repository.
